privacy.metaDescription: What data Kwizora processes about students and teachers, how long it is kept and how to delete it.
privacy.hosting: To be confirmed (hosting provider and data region not yet specified).
privacy.title: Privacy and student data
privacy.intro: This page is for teachers, schools and data protection officers (DPOs). It explains in plain terms what data Kwizora processes, why, for how long, and how to have it deleted.
privacy.frenchPrevails: This is a translation. The French version prevails.

summary.title: In short
summary.noAccount: Students have no account and give no name, email or age.
summary.codeOnly: To play, a student only enters the session code and a nickname of their choice.
summary.stored: We store the nickname, the answers and the response time, to compute the score and ranking.
summary.anonymised: {days} days after a session ends, nicknames are anonymised.
summary.deletion: The teacher can delete a session and all its data at any time.
summary.noTrackers: No advertising, no analytics, no third-party scripts on student pages.

students.title: Data collected about students
students.lead: When a student joins a session, Kwizora stores:
students.pseudo: the nickname they chose (we recommend not using their full name);
students.time: their response time, used to compute points;
students.score: the score and rank computed from those answers;
students.connection: a temporary technical connection identifier, needed for real-time play.
students.noAccount: There is no student account: no sign-up, no password, no email address. Kwizora does not ask for a surname, first name, date of birth, class or school.
students.device: The app stores no personal data on the student’s device. Only display preferences the student changes themselves (light or dark theme, language) are remembered by the browser; they cannot identify them.
students.purpose: This data is only used to run the quiz: showing the live ranking and letting the teacher see the session results. It is never sold or used for advertising.

teachers.title: Teacher data
teachers.text: To create quizzes and run sessions, the teacher creates an account with an email address, a username and a password (stored only as a hash, never in plain text). The quizzes and sessions they create are linked to their account. In their browser, a login token is kept in local storage so they stay logged in.

retention.title: Retention period
retention.text: Student data is kept for the duration of the session, then {days} days after the session ends. After that, it is anonymised automatically:
retention.pseudo: each nickname is replaced with a neutral label (“Joueur 1”, “Joueur 2”…);
retention.connection: the technical connection identifier is erased.
retention.stats: Only statistics not linked to any person remain (for example the success rate of a question), useful for the teacher to improve their quizzes.

deletion.title: Deletion on request
deletion.teacher: The teacher can delete a session from their dashboard at any time (“Delete the session and its data”). Deletion is permanent: it erases the session, the participant list and all their answers. Only the teacher who created the session can delete it.
deletion.student: A student or their legal guardians who want data deleted can contact the teacher who ran the session, or write to us at the address below.

hostingSection.title: Hosting
hostingSection.fonts: Fonts are served directly by Kwizora: displaying student pages triggers no request to any third-party service (fonts, analytics, social networks or advertising).

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: Under the GDPR, every data subject can request access to their data, its correction or erasure, and object to its processing. As students have no account, the request must allow us to find the session concerned (date, teacher, nickname used).
rights.cnil: If you believe your rights are not respected, you can lodge a complaint with the CNIL (the French data protection authority).

contactSection.title: Contact
contactSection.text: For any question or request about your data: {contact}
